ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Fraud on Local Communities
ideas.description: Investigate how the alleged $40M fraud in the Feeding Our Future program affects local communities and child nutrition.
questions: What are the long-term impacts on community trust?
ideas.insight: Understanding the local impact can reveal the extent of the program's failure and necessary reforms.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Federal Reserve Investigation
ideas.description: Dig deeper into the DOJ's investigation of Jerome Powell and the implications of the judge's ruling.
questions: What evidence did the judge consider?
How does this affect the Fed's operations?
ideas.insight: A thorough analysis can uncover potential patterns of political influence or lack of oversight.
